away.summary: The Senators are projected to start Linus Ullmark in goal. Key absences include Artem Zub (knee), Kurtis MacDermid (upper body), Andre Burakovsky (upper body), and suspended Ridly Greig. Jake Sanderson is expected to return after missing training camp time due to an undisclosed injury.

home.summary: The Maple Leafs are projected to start Sergei Bobrovsky in goal. Dakota Joshua (core) and Max Domi (undisclosed) are listed as injured and out. The team will dress the same 18 skaters used in their 2-1 win over the New York Islanders on Wednesday.
